_meta.note: Local speech models (spec 066 research R8, spec 081). languages: what an entry speaks; quality_rank: higher sounds better (spec 081 FR-012); temperature: Pocket sampling (spec 081 FR-015); files: fixed file list with SHA-256 where the engine has no built-in list. pocket: Kyutai Pocket TTS for sherpa-onnx, one folder per language in one repo. approx_size_bytes is the sum of every file the engine needs at the pinned revision (tts/files.rs).
_meta.source: https://huggingface.co/haex-space/pocket-tts-sherpa-onnx (CC BY 4.0), built from https://huggingface.co/KevinAHM/pocket-tts-onnx and the k2-fsa sherpa-onnx export; qwen3-tts: https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base-GGUF (Apache-2.0), spec 081 research R2
